✅ **Prompt Updated**: Showcase Review (showcase_review)

Updated prompt: showcase_review

📜 **Version 2** saved (use `action:"history"` to view)

**Changes**: +6 additions, -7 deletions

```diff
===================================================================
--- a/development/showcase_review/prompt.yaml
+++ b/development/showcase_review/prompt.yaml
@@ -1,7 +1,6 @@
 id: showcase_review
 name: Showcase Review
-description: Inspect actual showcase playback and render artifacts, assess
-  silent comprehension, motion, positioning and proof before preparing exports.
+description: Grade a rendered artifact against rubric.md by criterion id, with evidence tiers, controls and the five-part receipt.
 category: development
 systemMessageFile: system-message.md
 userMessageTemplateFile: user-message.md
===================================================================
--- a/development/showcase_review/user-message.md
+++ b/development/showcase_review/user-message.md
@@ -4,13 +4,13 @@
 Previous handoff:
 {{context | default("Read available chain history; report missing evidence.")}}
 
-Inspect the actual render, selected stills and manifest; do not grade output you have not viewed. Read the motion contract below and earlier story/treatment from history. Separate what exists from what was inspected and what remains unverified.
+Read, before writing, the project files under the production root's `v3/`: `creative-spec.md` (rulings D41–D53, medium, palette law, animation language), `script.md` (resource vocabulary and beats), `rubric.md` (criteria C1–C18 and the receipt shape). They are the contract; this prompt does not restate them.
 
+Grade the actual rendered artifact against `rubric.md` by criterion id; do not grade anything you have not viewed. Use only the four marks: HOLDS, FAILS, UNPROVEN, TASTE. Each mark cites its evidence at or above the criterion's minimum tier (still, 3x crop, consecutive frames, moving render, owner viewing) and names the failing control it beats. Measure where the rubric allows it: per-frame pixel change for twos versus ones (C16), two renders hashed for determinism (C12), a sampled pixel for identity pigments (C1).
+
 Motion contract:
 {{motion_contract | default("Use the recorded Motion Contract step; flag missing handoff.")}}
 
-Review silent first-view comprehension, exact product claim fidelity, pacing/reading holds, transitions, color-story continuity, logo/README continuity, typography clipping, artifact legibility and evidence labels. Record precise beat/frame/time for every material finding. Inspect start, payoff, transition boundaries and ending, plus full playback where the client has the ability. Executable probe results (duration/dimensions/frame counts/file outputs) require actual receipts; a model review is not an executable test. If a render is absent, report BLOCKED with required inputs instead of PASS. The client applies approved fixes only within assigned files, then re-renders and re-inspects affected beats.
+Write the receipt in the rubric's five parts, in order: Changed (by file); Grades (one line per criterion touched); Controls (which earlier study each flipped FAILS beats); Owner (at most two TASTE questions, each with the default the planner takes if unanswered); Next (one fix per FAILS). Save it as `v3/studies/<name>.md` beside the artifact copies, copied unchanged from `out/` with sha256 prefixes. A render that is absent is BLOCKED, not PASS. Propose a rubric change only through its Evolution rules: a new ruling adds a row; three consecutive HOLDS bakes one; a standing TASTE is ruled or deleted.
 
-Deliver review.md and export-manifest.json under owned paths. Include inspected paths and frames/times, criteria/findings, exact completed commands and results, negative control evidence, missing checks, source/provenance classes, final export paths and README/poster/short-loop recommendations. Public replacement/publishing remains a planner decision.
-
-Return: Inspected Evidence; Silent Comprehension; Visual and Motion Findings; Executable Checks; Corrections; Export Handoff; Concerns. End with actual artifact paths and final verification limits.
\ No newline at end of file
+Return: Inspected Evidence; Grades; Controls; Owner; Next; Rubric Evolution; Concerns.
\ No newline at end of file

```
